title: Lefschetz filtration and Perverse filtration on the compactified Jacobian
summary: Let $C$ be a complex integral curve with plannar singularities. Let $J$ be the compactified Jacobian of $C$. There are two filtrations on the cohomology group $H^*(J)$. One is obtained by the nilpotent morphism defined by cupping a certain ample divisor on $J$, which we call the Lefschetz filtration. To obtain the other filtration, we put $C$ into a family of curves $\mathcal{C}\rightarrow B$ so that $J$ can be embedded into a family $f:\mathcal{J}\rightarrow B$, and we let $B, \mathcal{C},\mathcal{J}$ be smooth.
